intro.programTitle: About the Low Carbon Fuel Standard
intro.programBody: The Low Carbon Fuels Act and its two regulations form British Columbia's Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS), which sets requirements that encourage the use of renewable and low carbon fuels. The LCFS offers incentives to organizations based on the amounts of greenhouse gas emissions avoided in comparison to conventional fossil-derived fuels.
intro.siteBody: This site provides public access to program tools and data — including the compliance unit calculator, approved carbon intensities, and credit market information. Registered fuel suppliers and government staff can log in to file and review compliance reports.

a1.title: Category A1
a1.body: Transfers are categorized A1 when the agreement date is within 30 days of the recorded transfer date.

a.title: Category A
a.body: The agreement to transfer credits was reached within six months of the credit transfer.

b.title: Category B
b.body: The agreement to transfer credits was reached six months to one year before the credit transfer.

c.title: Category C
c.body: The agreement was reached more than one year before the transfer, or falls outside any defined timeframe.

about.title: About this data
about.body: Figures are aggregated from credit transfers recorded under the Low Carbon Fuels Act. Periods with fewer than five transfers or three participating organizations are withheld to protect confidentiality, and no individual transaction prices are shown. Data may be restated as late reports are received.
